hypotheses.justification: The proof uses `hlen` in exactly one place: the `omega` step that turns `hi : i < (C.stepOfL Δ).length` into `hi' : i < next.length`. That bound already follows from `hlab` and `hx`. `hlab i hi` says `C.Q.labelAt (x ++ [i]) = some _`. By definition `labelAt q y = (q.atOpt y).map label`. `QuasiTab.atOpt_snoc` (PreInterpolant.lean:202) gives `q.atOpt (x ++ [i]) = (q.atOpt x).bind (fun n => n.children[i]?)`. Rewriting with `hx` and using that `(QNode k Δ next).children = next` holds by `rfl`, we get `(next[i]?).map label = some _`. So `next[i]? ≠ none`. If `next.length ≤ i`, then `List.getElem?_eq_none` would make it `none`, a contradiction; hence `i < next.length`. Replacement proof: `have h := hlab i hi; rw [QuasiTab.labelAt, QuasiTab.atOpt_snoc, hx] at h; by_contra hc; rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)] at h; simp at h` (with `QuasiTab.children` unfolded if needed). The rest of the proof is unchanged. `hlen` appears nowhere else in the statement, so it can be deleted.
